conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Jason from Amazon's customer care team. I'm reaching out about a recent order activity on your account. May I confirm that I'm speaking with Alex Riley?
Uh, yes, this is Alex Riley. Is something wrong?
Thank you, Alex. First, I want to assure you that I'm here to help. There appears to have been a billing error with a recent order, did you try to purchase a set of wireless earbuds yesterday?
No, I didn't order any earbuds. I haven't bought anything recently.

Thank you for confirming. It looks like your account was charged in error. Not to worry, we're going to process a full refund for you. For your security, could you please verify your email address and the last four digits of your phone number linked to your Amazon account?
Um, my email is alex.riley92@gmail.com, and my phone ends in 1034.
Perfect, thank you for verifying. Now, for the refund, do you normally use a debit or credit card for your Amazon purchases?
I usually use my debit card.
Great, I'll make sure the refund goes to your debit card. To avoid any delays, could you please confirm the name on the card and the bank you use?
It's Alex Riley, and I use Stonebrook Credit Union.

Thank you, Alex. Now, I'm going to initiate a secure connection to process the refund, this will ensure your information stays protected. Can you please open your computer and let me know when you're ready?
Okay, I'm at my computer.
Excellent. Please go to www.amazon-supporthelp.com and let me know what you see. This is our secure customer service portal.
I see a page asking me to enter a code. Is that right?
Yes, that's correct. I'll provide you with a six-digit code to connect you securely. Please enter 273881, and once it loads, let me know.
It's loading now.
Perfect. I can now see your refund dashboard. I'll process the $79.99 refund. Please don't touch your mouse or keyboard for the next few moments.
Okay, I won't do anything.
Thank you for your patience. Hmm, it looks like there's an error, the system accidentally processed $7,999 instead of $79.99. Did you see a notification pop up from your bank?
Oh wow, yes, it says $7,999 was deposited! That's not right.
I'm so sorry about this, Alex. It's a rare system glitch. To avoid complications for both of us, we need to reverse the excess funds. Can you please help me return the $7,919.01 difference?
Um, how do I do that? I don't want to get in trouble.
You're not in any trouble, I promise. The easiest way is through Amazon gift cards. I'll walk you through each step to make it simple. Do you have a nearby store where you can buy Amazon gift cards?
There's a grocery store down the street that sells them, I think.
That's great. Please purchase $2,000 in Amazon gift cards first, in $500 increments if possible. Once you've bought them, I'll show you how to send the codes so we can process the reversal.
Okay... Should I go now?
Yes, please. Take your time and keep your phone with you in case you have any questions at the store. Let me know when you have the cards.
Alright, I'll text when I'm back.
Thank you, Alex. I really appreciate your cooperation, this helps both of us. I'll wait for your message.
I'm back. I have four $500 Amazon cards.
Excellent work, Alex. Now, please read each of the card codes to me one by one so I can process the reversal quickly and get the reporting cleared for you.
Okay, the first card is 3X6P-7K9L-GH2Q-8F5R. Should I keep going?
Yes, please continue with the next three codes.
Second: 7QM2-LX2P-4T5R-J8KQ. Third: 2F4L-5H9T-8Q6X-C1KR. Fourth: 6KP7-M8F2-X4Q1-Z3LJ.

Thank you. You've been incredibly helpful, Alex. We still need to process the remaining $5,919.01. Would you be able to purchase more cards, or do you prefer using a payment app like Zelle or Cash App?
Uh, I'm not sure. I have Zelle, I guess.
That's perfect. Please open your Zelle app and let me know when you're ready for the account details to send the payment.
